The '''Deylerax system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Talcene sector/Legends|Talcene sector]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] containing the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Deylerax]].
